body: This code is currently identical (except for the comments) between Windows and Linux but it will probably not be long term if we do implement those changes, as other potential storage locations would differ
Thinking about this I might just move this into the crash handler for each platform and not touch `OS` at all, will do so when I implement the Windows side
`debuginfod` seems to be GPL3, so can't be integrated directly into the code, but calling system `debuginfod-find` utility, if it is installed should be fine.
